# Every window function name in pg_catalog on PostgreSQL 18.4 (postgres:18
# Docker image), from:
#
#   SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT proname, ' ' ORDER BY proname) FROM pg_proc
#   WHERE prokind = 'w' AND pronamespace = 'pg_catalog'::regnamespace;
cume_dist dense_rank first_value lag last_value lead nth_value ntile percent_rank rank row_number
